scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('docs')) fs.rmSync('docs', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'docs/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll', ''); fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll', '');"
